inherited_authorities.financial_event_truth: M2 canonical event and posting authority
inherited_authorities.documents: evidence links only; no general document storage

invariants: inventory movement does not itself prove a financial cost basis
cost of fulfillment requires a positive exact unit cost and verified provenance evidence
missing or unreliable historical cost is withheld and never represented as zero COGS
fulfillment cost reduces inventory/deferred-cost asset and creates no revenue
historical receipt numbers and content hashes are preserved
documents explain canonical facts but do not become financial authority
mapping replay is stable and conflicting replay fails closed
tenant and organization scope are mandatory
M7.2 does not execute commands, reroute writers, or perform cutover
